N/A credited because customer does not volunteer additional concerns after the one clarification.

evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No loop closure attempted. Rep restates process (email intro, phone call before, arrival window, payment method) but never asks 'Does that put those to rest?' or similar.

evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Rep confirms phone number (713-378-1769), email (cruise Carlos 1017 @gmail.com), move date (October 1st), arrival window (12:45–2:45 PM), unit numbers (1029, 235), and notes that this is within-complex. top_strength: Brianne gathered comprehensive logistics details—property type, floor/stories, square footage, parking distance, special items (TV, couches, bed), boxes, and second address—providing confidence in the estimate accuracy.
coaching_note: You skipped the entire opening framing (quid pro quo), never asked what concerns the customer wanted answered (their agenda), and jumped straight into probing; then you closed without the Two Promises, a genuine final concerns check, or an explicit ask for the business—this call reads more like a confirmation call than a sales call, and it misses the biggest load-bearing moments in the script.
